incremental.evidence: The transcript is append-only JSONL, read from a saved byte offset to the last line end (relay spike S4, 2026-10-09: a re-read with no new bytes took 37 ms on a 27.3 MB live transcript); test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1 resumes from a cursor, and agents/claude-code/test/test-conversation.ps1 times the no-change re-read of a large synthetic transcript.

stableTurnIds.evidence: Every user and assistant line carries the harness's own uuid (16,276 lines of a live Thrall transcript, 2026-10-10: no user or assistant line without one); a turn's id is that uuid, with #<n> for the n-th text block of a line that holds more than one. test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1 reads twice, and one turn at a time, and compares every id.

timestamps.evidence: Every user and assistant line carries timestamp, an ISO 8601 time in UTC (the same 16,276 lines, 2026-10-10); test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1 requires a time on every turn.

roles.evidence: A person's prompt is a user line marked origin.kind human; the model's words are assistant text blocks; tool results, notifications, meta lines and compaction summaries are told apart by the harness's own fields, never by their words (live Thrall transcript, 2026-10-10: 485 human prompts, 83 task notifications, 1,219 tool results, 116 meta lines, 2 compaction summaries). test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1 and agents/claude-code/test/test-conversation.ps1 plant each kind.

partialTurns.evidence: One API response is written as one line per content block, each line written whole (2,719 assistant lines, each holding exactly one block, 2026-10-10), so a text block once read never grows; a response's later blocks are later turns sharing its groupId (message.id). Only a torn last line can be incomplete, and it is not read until its line end is written (S4; test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1).

mutableHistory.evidence: The transcript is appended to, never edited: compaction appends a boundary and a summary line (2 of each in the live Thrall transcript, 2026-10-10) and /clear starts a new session with a new file. A file rewritten anyway is detected (its first 4 KiB or the line end before the cursor changed, or it shrank) and read again from the start as a rotation; test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1 rewrites one.

sessionLookup.evidence: The fleet's registry holds one record per session, named by its id, and the record's own role, label and parent fields are read from it, never derived (a live registry of 92 records, 2026-10-13, counted by shape only: 34 labels, every one of the label shape, and 58 records with none; 87 parents, every one a session id; 9 roles, and 83 records with none). test/test-conversation-conformance.ps1 describes an orc, its warg, a session with no label and the Thrall in a registry it makes in the temp folder, and agents/claude-code/test/test-conversation.ps1 damages the label, the record and the registry.
